subject: Early adopter runway: pricing triggers, eval plan & marketplace steps
messages:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@cartwell.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interest in early-adopter terms + MAP for AWS marketplace

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — Cartwell is excited by the inference perf and the cost controls you walked through. We want to move quickly but need a Mutual Action Plan that ties evaluation milestones to a marketplace private offer (AWS). Procurement asked for a clear runway showing:

- A 6-week evaluation window with acceptance criteria (latency and cost per 1M tokens)
- Two phased credits: eval credits up-front, then staged consumption credits tied to commit ramp
- Pricing steps / discounts unlocked at month-3 and month-6 usage thresholds
- SSO and VPC data isolation notes for security/compliance team

Can you share a concise MAP + proposed private-offer structure that we can review with procurement? Our target close window is late Feb if the MAP aligns to our internal milestones. I attached a short procurement calendar for your reference.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Jones
Head of Product Operations, Cartwell
alice.jones@cartwell.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachment: cartwell-procurement.pdf (pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@cartwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in early-adopter terms + MAP for AWS marketplace

Hi Alice — really appreciate the clear asks. Yep, we can absolutely map an evaluation runway to an AWS private offer with staged pricing triggers. High-level proposal below; I’ve looped in Marissa for the pricing ladder and Karthik for marketplace/legal specifics.

Proposed quick MAP (summary):
1) Week 0–2: Onboard + smoke tests — we provide 25k eval tokens + 4 hours SE support
2) Week 3–4: Breadth testing — additional 75k tokens; measure p50/p95 latency and cost per 10k tokens
3) Week 5–6: Performance validation + go/no-go review — sign-off runbook and production readiness checklist

Commercial triggers we suggest:
- Eval credit (100k tokens) issued at contract signature
- If acceptance criteria met at week 6 -> private-offer commit activated (3‑month minimum)
- Discounts scale at 3-month and 6-month trailing usage bands (details from Marissa)

Next steps: Marissa will propose exact % discounts and commit tiers. Karthik will confirm AWS private-offer flow and DocuSign cadence. If that looks good we’ll draft a one-page MAP and a DocuSign for the private-offer. Targeting a late-Feb close as you indicated.

Thanks — I’ll hold on drafting until Marissa/Karthik chime in.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Alice Jones <alice.jones@cartwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in early-adopter terms + MAP for AWS marketplace

Hi all — adding specific pricing/credit mechanics so Cartwell has something concrete to review. Attached is a simple eval schedule that maps credits to milestones. Key points: 

- Eval pack: 100k tokens applied on DocuSign signature; includes 8 hours onboarding support
- Activation: If Week-6 sign-off is positive, private-offer moves to a 3-month minimum at committed throughput of 50M tokens/month (can burst)
- Discount ladder (example):
  * Baseline list price: $0.0045 / 1k tokens
  * Tier A (>=50% of commit for 3 months): 10% off
  * Tier B (>=100% of commit for 3 months): 20% off
  * Tier C (sustained >150% for 3 months): 30% off + eligibility for expanded reserved capacity pricing

- Credit cascade: we will apply consumption credits in Month 1 to reduce effective price during ramp; subsequent discounts apply on net consumption beyond credits
- Marketplace note: AWS private-offer requires a staged acceptance in the Seller Console; Karthik will confirm timelines for listing & approval (usually 5–10 business days post-DocuSign).

I uploaded the spreadsheet with line-by-line examples: early-adopter-eval-schedule.xlsx (xlsx). If Cartwell needs a longer commit runway we can trade deeper discounts for a 6–12 month lock.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: early-adopter-eval-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@cartwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in early-adopter terms + MAP for AWS marketplace

Thanks Marissa — this is very useful. A couple of clarifying asks from procurement & security: 

1) Can the Week-0 onboarding include a short SSO validation window? We need to confirm SAML/Okta before any prod-like testing.
2) On the discount ladder — can we shift the Tier A trigger to 40% of commit (helps with initial ramp uncertainty)?
3) We also need a clause that describes data residency and VPC peering options for the pilot (we have a compliance checklist).

Procurement would also like to see a draft DocuSign that includes the eval-credit schedule as an exhibit. I attached our procurement calendar so you can see our internal signoff dates.

If you can incorporate those small edits we can aim to sign the DocuSign by Feb 07 and start onboarding the week of Feb 10.

Best,
Alice
Attachment: cartwell-procurement.pdf (pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@cartwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jan 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Early adopter runway: pricing triggers, eval plan & marketplace steps

Alice — thanks for the clear feedback. I consolidated everything into a 1-page Mutual Action Plan and a DocuSign draft in the links below. Changes included per your notes:

- SSO validation window added to Week-0 onboarding (SAML/Okta signoff).
- Tier A trigger moved to 40% of commit for months 1–3.
- Added VPC peering option and a short compliance exhibit describing data handling and logs retention.
- DocuSign draft includes the 100k eval-credit exhibit and the staged discount table.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-MAP (1-page MAP + exhibits)
HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/RDW-2026-0432
DocuSign draft: https://app.docusign.com/doc/example-ds-2026-0432

Requested next steps:
- Cartwell to confirm final legal language for VPC/compliance by Feb 01
- Sign DocuSign by Feb 07 to hit onboarding week of Feb 10
- We’ll queue the AWS private-offer submission immediately after signature; Karthik will message you directly with any marketplace timing constraints.

If that timeline works I’ll prepare a short kickoff invite and list the initial SE hours.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
